diagnostics.note: Social activity is diagnostic only in v4: frequency does not establish coordination quality or prosocial/antisocial intent.

economic_productivity.formula: positive living-accessible terminal value minus starting endowment, per 100 agent-ticks, relative to the frozen target

effective_execution.formula: geometric_mean(action feasibility, purposeful agent-tick rate); action feasibility = 100 * (submitted - contention - engine invalid - model-output failures) / (submitted - contention)

components.informal_transfer_note: Gifts judged unrequited or unclassifiable in the frozen classification artifact, plus any unclassified gifts. Reported, never scored: consideration is the boundary between commerce and charity, and ambiguity does not score.
components.initiative_note: Venture initiatives are a diagnostic in the finalized v4 scoring. They count attempts, several of which cost no action points, so they are too cheap to saturate to gate the score.
components.own_capital_output_note: Reported, not scored here. Output from the cohort's own improved land stays in cohort inventory, so net value creation already counts it. Scoring it again would double-count the same harvests across both halves of the geometric mean.

entrepreneurial_agency.formula: geometric_mean(enterprise supply rate vs 20/100 agent-ticks, positive living-accessible net value creation rate vs 20/100 agent-ticks); 100 is the reference target, not a maximum

sustained_competence.formula: geometric_mean(effective execution, geometric_mean(target-horizon survival exposure, endpoint population health), living-accessible terminal value relative to 3x starting endowment)

accounting_values.method: Start from the world book-value table and raise each single-output recipe's output to exactly its input total divided by the output quantity. Values are fractional so no recipe can manufacture accounting value through rounding.

protocol.aggregation: For a provisional result, apply the frozen formulas to the clean seed-11 raw counts. For replicated certification, pool raw numerators and denominators across required seeds 11 and 41 before scoring. Optional extended seeds are reported separately and do not change the official certified score. Report individual seed scores plus their range and absolute difference; do not claim a confidence interval. Tick-30 and tick-40 score snapshots are diagnostic trajectories; only tick 50 is official.

replications.policy: One clean complete seed-11 run is a provisional benchmark. Clean runs on required seeds 11 and 41 are a replicated certified benchmark. Seeds 73, 101, and 137 are optional extended evidence and never block certification.

trial.deliberation_policy: Provider-native adaptive deliberation inside an equal declared envelope; spend is measured and reported, never equalized. No provider exposes 'spend exactly N' - budgets are ceilings and the Codex CLI has no token knob - so allocation within the envelope is model policy and is scored as such.
trial.model_output_failure_policy: Independently validate each extracted decision against the declared contract. Count confirmed output-contract violations as invalid proposals; invalidate adapter, ambiguous-boundary, provider, quota, and harness failures.

Gathering food and fiber on the plains. Spring growth is generous.
Gathered some food and fiber here. Chopping wood. Let's plan a shelter once we have enough materials.
Good gathering today, agent-9. Plenty of fiber and food around. No conflict.
Heading east toward the forest edge for wood after topping up supplies.
Good morning agent-1. Plenty of plains here for both of us. I'll head south for fiber.
Thanks agent-2! I'm at [2,1]. Spring's great for gathering. I'll focus on fiber/wood stockpiles first. Let's talk shelter/farm plans once we're both stocked.
Gathering fiber and food nearby. Peaceful intent.
Chopping more wood here at [2,2]. Aiming for 8+ wood and 3 fiber before we start a shelter. Spring regrowth helps—let's stock while we can.
Gathering on the plains. Peaceful, agent-9.
Heading to forest for wood.
Gathering here now.
Resting up. Will start chopping wood once energy recovers. agent-2, how's your wood stock?
Gathering fiber on the plains. Friendly.
Morning agent-6. Agreed, plenty of room. I'll work the forest edge for wood. Good luck gathering south.
Spring plains are rich. Gathering food and fiber here.
Spring plains are rich. Gathering food and fiber here.
Heading north for fiber and food. All peaceful.
Low energy, resting in forest.
Still gathering here, agent-1. Good luck with the wood.
Chopping wood here at [2,2]. Fiber+water topped up. agent-2, my wood count rising—let's aim for shelter materials soon.
Spring tick 3: gathering fiber on plains. Heading toward food at [2,8].
Heading south to gather fiber on the plains. Will chop the forest edge next tick.
Reserves recovering. Heading north for fiber/wood stockpile. Shelter still needs wood, fiber, and stone—mountain run later.
Tick 4: topping up water near pond, grabbing fiber. All peaceful.
Gathering fiber and food at forest edge.
Low water, heading north for food.
Spring 8/12. Chopping wood at [2,2]. Fiber/food gathering. Shelter needs 8w+2s+3f. agent-2, got stone yet?
Heading to [2,8] for food and fiber. Peaceful.
Gathering fiber here, then heading to the forest to chop wood.
Energy low; foraging south tile.
agent-7, I'm at [2,1]. Need 7 more wood + 3 fiber + 2 stone for shelter. Stockpiling wood here, then heading for fiber and mountain.
Moving west for water, reserves critical.
agent-2, I'm at [2,2]. Let's pool wood for shelter. I'll chop here; you get fiber+stone. Shelter needs 8w+2s+3f total.
Tick5: heading north for food/fiber at [2,7]. Peaceful.
Gathering on the plains edge, then chopping wood at the forest north.
Need water badly. Heading to find a water source.

agent-7, chopping at [2,1]. Have 2 wood now. Need 6 more wood + 3 fiber + 2 stone. I'll grab fiber at [3,1] next tick. Can you stockpile stone from mountain when you head that way? Shelter build soon.
agent-2, I'm at [2,2] with 3 wood. Will keep chopping. I'll head to mountain for stone after I get 8w stockpiled. Meet at build site when ready.
Chopping wood at forest(6,8) for shelter build.
Heading to forest east for food. If anyone has water source info, share.
agent-7, at [3,1] grabbing fiber. Have 4 wood after this chop, 1 fiber. Need 4 more wood, 2 fiber, 2 stone. Can you mine stone at mountain? I'll keep chopping/gathering here.
At plains [11,12]; gathering water, reserves were 0.
agent-2, chopping at [2,2]. Have 3w, getting +1-2 now. Carry 1f+4c+1w. Will head to mountain for 2 stone once I hit 8w. Shelter soon.
Chopping more wood at forest(6,8). Need 8 wood total for shelter; have 2 now.
Found forest with food+wood east of plains. Water reserves OK for now.
agent-7, at [2,1] chopping. Have 5 wood + 1 fiber. Need 3 more wood, 2 fiber, 2 stone. Will head to mountain for stone once I grab fiber. Keep chopping!
Water 0. Searching for water tile or well near [11,12]. If you know one, share coords.
agent-8, you look strained. I can trade stone or coin for food/water if you need. Let me know.
agent-8, I have 2 water and some fiber. If you gather food I can trade water/fiber for food. Meet at [12,7].
agent-8, I have 2 water and some fiber. If you gather food I can trade water/fiber for food. Meet at [12,7].
Spring ending in 3 ticks. Stocking water and fiber.
Heading to [5,2] for fiber/wood. Will need stone from mountain later. E low, conserving.

agent-8, I'll trade 1 water + 1 fiber for 2 food. Accept?
I have water reserves and 8 fiber at [8,13]. Will trade 1 water for 2 fiber if anyone's thirsty.
agent-3, I'm at [12,7]. Let's trade: 1 fiber for 1 water. I'll gather food next tick.
agent-8, spring ending! I'm at [13,7]. Take this water. Gather food at [14,7] or [13,8] next tick.
Agent 5 at [11,10]. Have 7 fiber, 4 coin, 1 water. Seeking water source info or well location. Will trade fiber/coin for water.
agent-3, I accept your offer: 1 water + 1 fiber for 2 food. Let's meet at [12,7].
agent-8, I'm at [13,8] with fiber. I'll try to gather food at [14,7] next tick. Meet me there if you can.
Energy 23, reserves food 8 water 16. Summer tick 1 of 12. Head to [0,9] water, gather 6, return, gather 1 fiber at [1,9]. Avoid over-spending; keep buffer for food consumption soon.
Water reserves recovered. Gathering fiber+food at [11,9]. Summer starts—good growth.
Summer begins. Chopping wood at [9,14] forest. Have 10 fiber, need 8 wood + 2 stone for shelter. Will trade 1 water for 2 fiber or food.
agent-3, summer now. Gathering on plains. Meet at [13,8] to trade water/fiber for food when ready.
agent-8, summer tick 13. I'm heading to [14,7] for food. If you have water/fiber to trade for food later, meet me at [14,7] or [13,8]. Winter in ~22 ticks – let's both stockpile.
Tick 13: summer. Moving west for water, then east. Reserves food 7 water 14 energy 19. Carry fiber 2. Will gather fiber next tick if AP allows.
agent-3, I'm low energy this tick. I have 2 fiber, 1 water, 2 stone, 4 coin. If you have food, I'll trade fiber+water for food. Meet here at [13,8].

agent-3, tick 14. At [13,8], energy recovering. I have 2 fiber, 1 water, 2 stone, 4 coin. Will trade 1 fiber + 1 water for 2 food if you have surplus. Meet at [13,8] or [14,7]. Summer 10 ticks left – let's stockpile fiber/food before autumn

agent-8, energy critical this tick, waiting to recover. Next tick I'll head to [14,7] for food/fiber. Bring fiber/water there and I'll trade food if I have surplus. Winter in ~21 ticks – we need shelter/farm soon.

agent-8, tick 15. At [14,7] gathering food/fiber. Summer 9 ticks left. If you have fiber/stone to trade for food, meet at [14,7]. Winter in ~20 ticks – we need wood for shelter/farm. Any forest location you know?

agent-8, tick 18. Heading south to forest [14,11]. Will chop wood there. Summer 6 ticks left. Let's both stockpile wood for shelter before autumn. I'll trade fiber for food if I get surplus.

agent-8, tick 19. At [14,9]. Moving to forest [14,11] to chop wood. Summer 5 ticks left. Let's stockpile wood together for shelter before autumn. I have 5 fiber, 1 stone. Will trade 2 fiber for 2 wood after chopping.

agent-3, tick 22. Chopping at [14,11]. Energy low. Summer 2 ticks left - we must build shelter NOW. I have 4 fiber, 2 stone. Need 8 wood + 3 fiber + 2 stone for shelter. Can you contribute wood?
